t: A state owned personally by King Leopold II of Belgium, recognised at the Berlin Conference and proclaimed in 1885.
Forced collection of wild rubber, enforced by the Force Publique through hostage-taking and mutilation, caused mass death.
An international campaign led by Roger Casement and E. D. Morel forced Belgium to annex it as the Belgian Congo in 1908.
dyk: Leopold II ruled the Congo Free State for twenty-three years without ever setting foot in it, governing by decree from Brussels.
ev: Henry Morton Stanley begins building stations on the Congo River for Leopold
Leopold proclaims the Congo Free State after the Berlin Conference
The Yeke king Msiri is killed and Katanga is secured for the state
The Force Publique defeats the Swahili-Arab traders of the eastern Congo
Roger Casement’s report is published and the Congo Reform Association is founded
Belgium annexes the territory as the Belgian Congo
